summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 6,832,029 common shares for ~$71.9 million under Sections 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S, based on NAV as of May 31, 2026. The filing also discloses a declared cash distribution for June 30, 2026, with per-share amounts net of fees. There are no special-situation elements such as a strategic transaction, tender offer, or activist campaign. The share issuance is a routine capital raise, and the dividend declaration is ordinary course. No watch items or risk-arb angle—no special situation exists.
